01.n: The verb carries the Hebrew 'and' that opens the verse, given here as the plain 'And' before the subject.

02.r: The personal name of Israel's God.

03.r: Marks Aaron as the one spoken to.

04.r: The high priest, head of the priestly house within Levi.
04.n: Gesenius: the elder brother of Moses, consecrated high priest by his brother.

05.r: The land the other tribes are to receive.
05.n: 'Their' is the rest of Israel. The brief's lexicon lists 'tribal territory' among this noun's senses.

07.r: Aaron is to receive no share of the land as his own.
07.n: The verb from which the noun 'inheritance' comes. Gesenius: to receive any thing as a possession, very frequently used of Israel acquiring Canaan. The KJV and most others turn the verb into 'have no inheritance'; the YLT keeps the verb.

08.r: No allotted piece of the land is to be his.
08.n: BDB: portion, tract, territory, of land. Our register renders this word 'portion', the same word that names the LORD himself later in the verse.

09.r: Negates the having of a portion.

10.r: No portion will exist for him.
10.n: Literally 'a portion shall not be to you', the usual Hebrew way of saying 'you shall not have'.

11.r: Aaron, as the one who would own it.

12.r: Among the tribes when the land is shared out.

13.r: The LORD names himself as what Aaron receives.
13.n: The Hebrew has no verb here: 'I, your portion and your inheritance'. The pronoun is written out, which gives it weight.

14.r: In place of land, the LORD himself is Aaron's share.
14.n: The same word as 'a portion' earlier in the verse: the portion denied in the land is answered by the LORD as portion. The brief's lexicon lists 'portion, award (from God)' among its senses.

15.r: What a tribe would hold as land, Aaron holds in the LORD.
15.n: Gesenius notes this noun is often used of the territory assigned to each tribe. Calling the LORD Aaron's inheritance answers the 'inherit' denied at the start of the verse.

16.r: Aaron stands within Israel, though without land of his own.

17.n: STEPBible tags this occurrence with the sense 'descendant, people'. The BSB says 'the Israelites'.

_extra.18: ὅτι (for, because): added by the Greek translators; nothing in the Hebrew answers to it.

07.n: κληρονομέω, inherit, the Greek verb our register renders 'inherit'.

08.n: μερίς, portion, the Greek word our register renders 'portion'.

16.n: The brief prints μέσῳ and the following article τῶν as one word, ἐν μέσῳ τῶν, 'in the midst of'.
